game.title: Overcooked
game.version: Stable PC build; trusted guide updated July 2026

roadmap.title: Complete and three-star the Story
roadmap.description: Play from Intro Apocalypse through The Peckening, aiming for three stars while collecting every themed-kitchen milestone and extinguishing one deliberate fire.

roadmap.title: Clean up three-star results
roadmap.description: Replay any base Story kitchen below three stars; DLC kitchens are excluded and The Peckening grants three stars automatically when cleared.

roadmap.title: Finish local-mode cleanup
roadmap.description: Complete level 1-1 with a split input, then connect a second controller and finish one full Versus match.

achievements.description: Deliver a recipe to the Great and Terrifying Ever Peckish.
achievements.summary: During Intro Apocalypse, prepare the first chopped-vegetable salad, then carry the plate to the @npc{Great and Terrifying Ever Peckish}'s serving window.

guide.context: Intro Apocalypse has no score threshold and awards three stars when the tutorial encounter is completed.

steps.text: Start Story mode and enter the opening @loc{Intro Apocalypse} encounter.
Take the vegetables shown on the first ticket, chop them at the board, and place the completed salad on a plate.
Carry the plated salad to the serving window facing the @npc{Great and Terrifying Ever Peckish}; the achievement unlocks with the first accepted delivery.

achievements.description: Complete Overcooked and save the Onion Kingdom!
achievements.summary: Clear all 29 earlier Story kitchens, then serve every required order in the four phases of the final kitchen, @loc{The Peckening}.

guide.context: The Peckening has no score target and grants three stars automatically. The timer is 16 minutes solo or 12 minutes 30 seconds with two players, and failed tickets can summon fireballs that ignite kitchen tiles.

steps.text: Complete the base Story route through level 6-4 to unlock @loc{The Peckening}, keeping the @item{Fire Extinguisher} reachable during the finale.
In phase one, prepare and serve the four requested soups; in phase two, serve four burgers consisting of two plain burgers, one lettuce burger, and one works burger.
In phase three, serve two fish-and-chips orders and three pizzas, including at least one cheese pizza and the requested mushroom or sausage variants.
Phase four starts with tomato soup, followed by a works burger and fish and chips. The fourth ticket is either mushroom pizza or sausage pizza, and the fifth ticket is tomato salad.
Deliver the final phase-four dish before time expires to complete @loc{The Peckening} and save the Onion Kingdom.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen in the haunted forest.
achievements.summary: Finish haunted-forest Story level @loc{4-1} with at least one star.

guide.context: Level 4-1 introduces cheese, sausage, and mushroom pizzas, while its two horizontal counters trade positions at roughly one-minute intervals.

steps.text: Advance through the Story map until @loc{4-1} opens, then enter that haunted-forest kitchen.
Chop dough, tomato, cheese, and any requested sausage or mushroom, combine the ingredients, and bake each pizza in an oven.
Move needed ingredients and finished pizzas before the counters shift, then deliver enough correct orders to finish level 4-1 with at least one star.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen on a pirate ship
achievements.summary: Finish pirate-ship Story level @loc{1-3} with at least one star.

guide.context: The ship's two vertical work platforms change sides about every 30 seconds, leaving only one side able to reach the chopping boards; returned plates arrive clean.

steps.text: Complete Story levels 1-1 and 1-2, then enter the pirate-ship kitchen at @loc{1-3}.
Chop three matching onions, tomatoes, or mushrooms for each soup ticket, cook the ingredients together in a pot, and plate the finished soup.
Transfer ingredients toward the chopping boards before the platforms switch sides, then serve enough soups to finish level 1-3 with at least one star.

achievements.description: Be awarded three stars in every kitchen
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{three stars} on all 30 base Story kitchens, from Intro Apocalypse through @loc{The Peckening}; DLC kitchens are excluded.

guide.context: Three-star score thresholds rise with player count. Two-player co-op avoids solo chef-switching without the higher targets and congestion of three- or four-player teams, while The Peckening awards its stars automatically when cleared.

steps.text: Confirm three stars on @loc{Intro Apocalypse} and Story levels 1-1 through 1-6, then replay every flag in that range that shows fewer than three stars.
Check levels 2-1 through 2-4, 3-1 through 3-4, and 4-1 through 4-4; replay each listed flag below three stars until it displays three stars.
Check levels 5-1 through 5-6 and 6-1 through 6-4; replay each listed flag below three stars while serving tickets promptly and in queue order to preserve tip points.
Complete @loc{The Peckening} for its automatic three-star result; when all 30 base Story flags show three stars, the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen in low earth orbit
achievements.summary: Finish low-orbit Story level @loc{5-1} with at least one star.

guide.context: The kitchen is divided into two work areas, and green buttons move the shared ingredient-and-sink chamber between them; assigning one burrito type to each side keeps both chefs productive.

steps.text: Advance through the Story map until @loc{5-1} opens, then enter the first low-orbit kitchen.
When the shared chamber reaches a side, stock rice, tortillas, chicken, and beef before pressing the green button to pass the chamber across.
Cook rice in a pot, chop and fry the requested meat, combine both with a tortilla, and deliver enough beef and chicken burritos to finish level 5-1 with at least one star.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen of the underworld.
achievements.summary: Finish lava-filled Story level @loc{5-2} with at least one star.

guide.context: Level 5-2 spreads the burrito stations across four islands. Three bridges change alignment about every 30 seconds, fireballs cross the center, and only one rice pot sits beside the chopping board.

steps.text: Complete Story level 5-1, then enter the underworld kitchen at @loc{5-2}.
Cook rice continuously in the lone pot, chop and fry the requested chicken or beef, and assemble each order with a tortilla.
Cross only while the bridges are stationary, avoid the central fireballs, and deliver enough burritos to finish level 5-2 with at least one star.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen while playing with a split pad
achievements.summary: Configure one keyboard or gamepad as a @mechanic{two-player split input}, then finish Story level @loc{1-1} with that split-pad setup active.

guide.context: The correctly split input displays a different player color on each half. One person can earn the achievement by controlling one split chef through the simple 1-1 onion-soup target.

steps.text: On the Story level-selection map, press @mechanic{T} to open the split-pad settings.
Choose a two-player layout such as @mechanic{Keyboard 2 Player Split}, and confirm that the input graphic shows one player color on each half.
Enter Story level @loc{1-1} without changing the split setup, prepare and serve enough onion soups for one star, and continue through the result screen.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen in the Arctic.
achievements.summary: Finish icy Story level @loc{3-1} with at least one star.

guide.context: Level 3-1 is a compact iceberg with slippery movement, four fryers, two chopping boards, three plates, and a sink; its tickets request fish, chips, or both together.

steps.text: Advance through the Story map until @loc{3-1} opens, then enter the first Arctic kitchen.
Move around the iceberg in a consistent direction, chop the requested fish and potatoes, fry them, and combine both items only when the ticket shows fish and chips together.
Wash returned plates and deliver enough correct orders to finish level 3-1 with at least one star.

achievements.description: Complete a kitchen on the road.
achievements.summary: Finish moving-truck Story level @loc{2-1} with at least one star.

guide.context: The upper truck contains the stoves, buns, plates, and serving window, while the lower truck contains meat, vegetables, and chopping boards. The trucks repeatedly separate, and used plates return clean.

steps.text: Complete Story World 1, then enter the road kitchen at @loc{2-1}.
Keep one chef on each truck: chop meat, lettuce, and tomato below, then pass prepared ingredients upward whenever the trucks reconnect.
Cook meat and assemble the requested plain, lettuce, or works burgers on the upper truck, then serve enough orders to finish level 2-1 with at least one star.

achievements.displayName: Does not play well with others
achievements.description: Complete a kitchen in versus mode
achievements.summary: Connect a second controller and finish one full @mechanic{Versus} match; no orders or victory are required.

guide.context: Completing Story level 1-3 unlocks the first Versus kitchen. The achievement checks for a completed match, so the five-minute timer must expire and reach the result screen.

steps.text: Finish Story level @loc{1-3} to unlock a Versus kitchen, then connect a second controller so two local sides are active.
From the main menu choose @mechanic{Versus}, select any available kitchen, and start the match.
Either play normally or leave both sides idle, but remain in the match until the full five-minute timer expires and the result screen appears.

achievements.summary: Let an onion soup ignite in Story level @loc{1-1}, then spray the @item{Fire Extinguisher} until every flame is gone.

guide.context: Warning beeps only indicate that food is overheating; the soup must remain on the burner until visible flames appear before extinguishing can satisfy the achievement.

steps.text: Enter Story level @loc{1-1}, chop three onions, place them in a pot, and leave the pot on the burner after the soup finishes cooking.
Continue waiting through the warning beeps until the pot and nearby kitchen tile show visible flames.
Pick up the @item{Fire Extinguisher}, aim at the burning pot and tiles, and hold the use action until all flames disappear.
